name: AsciiDoc Files
changes: The AsciiDoc Files notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Hold Ctrl or Cmd as you click a cross reference to open its target in a new tab.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. AsciiDoc Files is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping your AsciiDoc files in Obsidian.
